items: Amazon extends 3.5% fuel surcharge to more services. Amazon will apply its 3.5% fuel and logistics surcharge to transportation fees for bulk storage and replenishment services, Supply Chain Dive reported. The surcharge starts in February, and the article gives no specific day.

EasyPost to go public via SPAC merger. EasyPost agreed to combine with American Drive Acquisition Company (Nasdaq: ADAC) at a $479 million pre-money equity value and a $576 million pro forma enterprise value. The combined company is expected to trade on Nasdaq as EZPO, and no change to carrier rates or service was stated.

Sen. Cotton urges CFIUS review of J&T. In a Nov. 17 letter to Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, Cotton asked CFIUS to review J&T Express's stake in SwiftX, a parcel carrier delivering to homes in 12 states, and its other U.S. carrier investments, including SpeedX. No CFIUS review has been reported as opened.
